entry.title: Lowe’s launches Black Friday deals in October
entry.summary: As shoppers seek Black Friday and Cyber Week discounts, Lowe’s is spreading out its sales events.

entry.title: Gen Z, Gen Alpha and the AI-ificiation of retail this holiday season
entry.summary: AI is “rewiring” the brains of today’s youth, at the same time that they’re craving physical experiences. Can retailers strike the right balance?

entry.title: Reporter’s notebook: Inside Scheels’ sporting goods wonderland
entry.summary: Come for the sporting goods, stay for the animatronic Abe Lincoln. And whatever you do, don’t expect your average retail experience.

entry.title: Where has the aspirational luxury consumer gone?
entry.summary: High-end brands have raised their prices in the post-pandemic economy. They’re selling less in part because fewer consumers can afford them.

entry.title: Nordstrom expands FAO Schwarz offerings, debuts new app features for holidays
entry.summary: The department store revamped its Nordy marketing character and is offering same-day beauty deliveries at select locations this season.

entry.title: Hasbro opens studio focused on Dungeons & Dragons
entry.summary: The new Wizards of the Coast Studios in Montréal will focus on developing content for the D&D franchise.

entry.title: Moody’s upgrades retail and apparel outlook as tariffs ease
entry.summary: The firm now expects “solid household finances” to lead to more stability in the sector, although rising energy costs and geopolitical risks are still a factor.

entry.title: Saks channels ‘main character energy’ for first post-bankruptcy holiday
entry.summary: A few months after its parent company exited Chapter 11, a leaner Saks Fifth Avenue is out to show it still has holiday heft.

entry.title: Toy prices jump 4.2% ahead of the holidays
entry.summary: The September price bump came amid a “tough” inflation report, with the overall Consumer Price Index up 0.6%.

entry.title: Target wants more efficient stores. An upgraded employee app could help.
entry.summary: The retailer’s myDay app features a newly customizable home screen functionality and will soon include access to AI-backed insights.
